sources.title: Secure Software Development Framework
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.scope: Selected practices and tasks used by AWQ mappings.
sources.limitation: The catalogue is not a complete reproduction of SP 800-218.

controls.title: Identify and document all security requirements for the organization's software development infrastructures and processes
Specify which tools or tool types must or should be included in each toolchain
Follow recommended security practices to deploy and maintain tools and toolchains
Store all forms of code based on the principle of least privilege
Securely archive the necessary files and supporting data for each software release
Review the software to identify and eliminate vulnerabilities

sources.title: Supply-chain Levels for Software Artifacts
sources.publisher: SLSA community, a Linux Foundation project
sources.scope: Selected Build track producer and provenance requirements.
sources.limitation: AWQ mappings do not assert a SLSA level.

sources.title: System Package Data Exchange Specification
sources.scope: Pinned Core, Software and Simple Licensing graph profile for deterministic release SBOMs.
sources.limitation: The AWQ profile is schema-validated evidence, not SPDX trademark certification or complete license compliance analysis.

sources.title: Open Source Project Security Baseline
sources.scope: Selected controls directly supported or related to AWQ requirements.
sources.limitation: Mappings do not assert OSPS Baseline compliance or maturity.

controls.title: Assign only minimum necessary CI/CD job privileges
Prevent unintentional storage of unencrypted sensitive data
Commit a direct language dependency list when supported
Major changes should add or update automated tests

sources.title: Python Language Reference
sources.scope: Python 3.12 grammar used by the syntax requirement.
sources.limitation: Compilation under one interpreter does not establish semantic conformance across implementations.

sources.title: The JavaScript Object Notation Data Interchange Format
sources.limitation: AWQ parsing does not validate an application-specific schema.

sources.title: CommonMark Specification
sources.scope: Link destination syntax relevant to local documentation checks.
sources.limitation: AWQ does not claim full CommonMark conformance.

sources.title: POSIX Shell Command Language
sources.limitation: POSIX specifies hash-bang input as unspecified; AWQ shebang policy is a portability convention, not POSIX conformance.
